name: Playworlds
summary: 由 AI 游戏主持人回应玩家选择的角色扮演冒险。官方披露实时叙事、伙伴对话和合成语音，也披露部分视觉与商店图像在制作中使用 AI。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Playworlds uses generative AI during gameplay for game-master narration, companion dialogue, story outcomes, and synthesized speech based on player choices. Text processing uses services accessed through OpenRouter and Google Gemini; speech synthesis uses MiniMax. Responses are generated live and may vary between sessions. AI tools also assisted preparation of campaign and character material and portions of the visual and Steam store artwork.
